pages.title: mgr modules, CLI tools and orchestration: every interaction with the MDS

features.name: mgr libcephfs connection pool
features.description: mgr modules mount CephFS through pooled libcephfs handles (<=5 per fs per pool, 60 s idle close) as the mgr cephx entity with client_mount_uid/gid=0, client_quota=false, client_check_pool_perm=false, client_respect_subvolume_snapshot_visibility=false, client_fscrypt_as=false; addresses registered with the mgr so the mon blocklists them on mgr failover.
features.notes: Many concurrent sessions from one mgr entity; abort_conn when fs recreated.

features.name: MDS tell commands via libcephfs mds_command
features.description: MgrModule.send_command/tell_command for MDS targets go through LibCephFS.mds_command2 -> Client::mds_command, which resolves the target with FSMap::parse_role first (a bare integer naming an 'in' rank of the legacy fs is a rank), then gid, '*', or daemon name, skips laggy daemons and sends MCommand; the MDS answers -EACCES unless the session caps are allow_all, then queues the command on the admin socket.

features.name: vxattr routing in libcephfs
features.description: Client-local vxattrs (layout, rstat, quota, dir pin, snap btime, mirror info, fscrypt) are computed from InodeStat after a forced getattr; other ceph.* names go to MDS GETVXATTR, which libcephfs only sends if the MDS advertises CEPHFS_FEATURE_OP_GETVXATTR (17) (else -ENODATA); -ENODATA falls back to plain xattrs. ceph.fscrypt.file set becomes SETATTR SIZE|FSCRYPT_FILE.

features.name: fs volume create/rm/rename/ls/info
features.description: Creates pools cephfs.<v>.meta/.data (bulk), fs new, orchestrator mds.<v> service; rm: orchestrator remove, fs fail, fs rm, pool rm (needs mon_allow_pool_delete); rename: fs rename + pool rename + service swap; info: statx(/volumes) rbytes, pending deletions, pool stats.

features.name: subvolume groups
features.description: Groups are directories /volumes/<group> with optional quota, pool layout (explicit or nearest ancestor), uid/gid, mode, normalization/casesensitive; ls/exist/getpath/info/resize/rm/pin/charmap.

features.name: subvolume create (v2 layout)
features.description: Creates /volumes/<g>/<s>/<uuid>, sets ceph.dir.subvolume on /volumes/<g>/<s> (v2; uuid dir in v1), applies quota/layout/pool namespace fsvolumens__<g>_<s>/uid/gid/mode/earmark/charmap/enctag, writes INI .meta via tmp+fsync+rename, creates /volumes/_<g>:<s>.meta.
features.notes: Depends on root dir exposing a layout (get_ancestor_xattr).

features.name: subvolume removal, trash and async purge
features.description: rm renames the base dir to /volumes/_deleting/<uuid> (or with retained snapshots moves <uuid> to <base>/.trash and symlinks it from _deleting); 4 purge threads rmtree entries via openat/unlinkat; ESTALE trick purges retained subvolumes after last snapshot removal.
features.notes: All bulk deletion is client-driven unlink/rmdir traffic to the MDS.

features.name: snapshot retention on subvolume removal
features.description: v2 subvolumes can be removed while retaining snapshots (state snapshot-retained, path empty), recreated as a new uuid incarnation, and cloned from retained snapshots.

features.name: subvolume resize via quota
features.description: resize sets ceph.quota.max_bytes on the data dir (inf/infinite = 0 removes quota); --no_shrink compares with dir st_size (rbytes); output bytes_used/bytes_quota/bytes_pcent.

features.name: subvolume/group pinning
features.description: fs subvolume(group) pin sets ceph.dir.pin (int rank), ceph.dir.pin.distributed (0/1) or ceph.dir.pin.random (float) on the subvolume base dir or group dir.

features.name: charmap (case sensitivity/normalization/encoding)
features.description: Sets ceph.dir.casesensitive/normalization/encoding, reads ceph.dir.charmap, removes ceph.dir.charmap; MDS requires empty dir without snapshots (ENOTEMPTY).

features.name: earmark and enctag
features.description: Plain xattrs user.ceph.subvolume.earmark (nfs/smb scope grammar) and user.ceph.subvolume.enctag (<=255 chars); NFS module sets/validates earmark on export.

features.name: subvolume user and snapshot metadata
features.description: Key/value metadata stored in the .meta INI ([USER_METADATA], [SNAP_METADATA_<snap>]); not MDS snapshot metadata.

features.name: subvolume snapshots
features.description: mkdir/rmdir/readdir in <snapbase>/.snap (v1 <uuid>/.snap, v2 <subvol>/.snap); filters inherited '_name_ino' snapshots; info via ceph.snap.btime and ceph.dir.layout.pool; refuses names equal to group snapshot names.

features.name: snapshot clone
features.description: Async cloner threads copy a snapshot into a new clone subvolume with cptree (openat/read/write/fsync/chown/chmod/utimens/symlink), apply quota afterwards, track clones via /volumes/_index/clone symlinks and [clone snaps]; status with rstat-based progress; cancel; progress events in ceph -s.
features.notes: Reads snapshot data through snapped inodes; requires symlink st_size==target length and ctime ordering.

features.name: subvolume authorize/deauthorize/authorized_list
features.description: Two JSON metadata files per auth id and per subvolume guarded by libcephfs flock(LOCK_EX); cephx caps mds 'allow r|rw path=<data path>', osd pool/namespace, mon r via auth get-or-create/caps/rm.

features.name: subvolume evict
features.description: Per up rank thread waits for up:active/clientreplay, sends 'session evict' with filters auth_name=<id>, client_metadata.root=<data path>; retries on ETIMEDOUT.

features.name: snapshot visibility
features.description: fs subvolume snapshot_visibility set/get toggles ceph.dir.subvolume.snaps.visible on the subvolume base dir (and on the data dir if it has its own quota realm).

features.name: fs quiesce
features.description: Resolves subvolume members to data paths and forwards 'quiesce db' to mdsmap.qdb_leader (one_shot, retry on -ENOTTY with returned leader).

features.name: subvolume quarantine
features.description: Sends 'quarantine enable|disable path=/volumes/<group>/<subvol>' to the first active MDS without opening the subvolume; info reports quarantine enabled on EACCES.

features.name: subvolume version discovery and upgrade
features.description: Legacy subvolumes get /volumes/_legacy/<md5>.meta; v1 without snapshots upgraded to v2 by rewriting version; every open re-marks ceph.dir.subvolume.

features.name: scheduled snapshots and retention
features.description: Timer per schedule mkdirs <path>/.snap/scheduled-<UTC ts>; prunes by n/m/h/d/w/M/y retention capped at mds_max_snaps_per_dir-1; schedules in a libcephsqlite DB stored in the CephFS metadata pool (default namespace objects snap_db_v0.db.*).
features.notes: For v2 subvolumes the schedule path is <data dir>/.. (subvolume base).

features.name: snapshot mirroring enable/peers/bootstrap
features.description: Creates cephfs_mirror object in the metadata pool, fs mirror enable/disable/peer_add/peer_remove mon commands, sets ceph.mirror.info (XATTR_CREATE) on the remote root, bootstrap via fs authorize / rwps.

features.name: mirror directory distribution
features.description: Directory-to-instance map and instances kept in omap of cephfs_mirror (dir_map_*, instance_*), notifications to cephfs_mirror.<instance>, heartbeat notify every 1 s, osd blocklist of unresponsive instances.

features.name: mirror checkpoints
features.description: Checkpoint keys cephfs.mirror.checkpoint.* written as MDS snapshot metadata via CEPH_MDS_OP_SNAP_METADATA (payload string key, string value, u32 flag; CREATE=1, EXCL=2, REMOVE=4; CREATE|EXCL to add, REMOVE to drop); latest snapshot = highest snap id.
features.notes: MDS handler has no check_access; mirror daemon with mds 'allow r' writes checkpoints.

features.name: cephfs-mirror daemon replication
features.description: Per directory: flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB, owner=thread id) on remote dir root, read then set ceph.mirror.dirty_snap_id; if the remote dirty_snap_id equals the previous/current snap id use local snapdiff (READDIR_SNAPDIFF) + file blockdiff (FILE_BLOCKDIFF), else full crawl; remote writes, ceph_sync_fs, mksnap with metadata primary_snap_id, propagate snapshot deletes/renames.

features.name: fs perf stats (MDS perf queries)
features.description: stats module registers per-rank client, subvolume and global MDS perf queries (key types mds_rank/client_id/subvolume_path, counter types 0-21) through the mgr; rank 0 MetricAggregator answers; client metadata from 'client ls' to every daemon with rank 0 in the FSMap (hostname/root/feature_bits mandatory); output version 2.

features.name: cephfs-top
features.description: curses UI using mgr command 'fs perf stats' (requires version 2 and expected global_counters), mon 'fs ls' and 'mgr module ls'; default id client.fstop.

features.name: fs status
features.description: Shows ranks/state/activity from FSMap and MDS perf counters mds_mem.{dn,ino,dir,cap}, mds_sessions.session_count, rates of mds_server.handle_client_request and mds_log.replayed; versions from daemon metadata.

features.name: dashboard CephFS
features.description: REST/GUI: perf counter series, session ls/client evict to <fscid>:0, fs authorize, file browser via libcephfs (dirs, snapshots, quotas, rstats), delegates volumes/snap_schedule/mirroring to those modules.

features.name: prometheus MDS metrics
features.description: Exports mds_metadata/fs_metadata from FSMap and all unlabeled perf counters received by the mgr.

features.name: ceph-exporter admin-socket scraping
features.description: Per-host exporter pings each daemon asok and issues 'counter dump', 'counter schema', 'config show' (pid_file).

features.name: MDS task status in service map
features.description: MDS pushes 'scrub status' into the mgr service map every mds_task_status_update_interval while scrubbing; shown in ceph -s.

features.name: mds_autoscaler
features.description: Sets orchestrator mds.<fs> placement count to max_mds + standby_count_wanted on FSMap changes.

features.name: cephadm MDS deployment
features.description: Sets mds_join_fs=<service_id> for mds.<service_id>, keyring caps mon 'profile mds' osd 'allow rw tag cephfs *=*' mds 'allow', daemon id <svc>.<host>.<6 random>, container /usr/bin/ceph-mds -n mds.<id> -f --setuser ceph --setgroup ceph --default-log-*.

features.name: cephadm MDS upgrade
features.description: Disables standby-replay, reduces max_mds to 1 (or fs fail with orchestrator fail_fs), waits for lone active MDS, consults mds ok-to-stop when spare daemons exist, redeploys, checks ceph versions, restores max_mds/joinable/standby-replay. Rotates an MDS cephx key first if health check AUTH_INSECURE_SERVICE_KEY_TYPE names it; mutes AUTH_INSECURE_* warnings during the upgrade.

features.name: rook CephFilesystem
features.description: apply_mds creates/patches CephFilesystem CR with metadataServer.activeCount and activeStandby=True; operator behavior outside repo.

features.name: NFS exports of CephFS
features.description: Validates export path via libcephfs statx, sets/checks nfs earmark, creates client.nfs.<cluster>.<fs>.<hash> with mds 'allow rw path=<cmount_path>', writes Ganesha FSAL CEPH config in the .nfs pool.

features.name: cephfs-journal-tool
features.description: Inspect/export/import/reset journals (reset needs --yes-i-really-really-mean-it and writes an EResetJournal event), header get/set/recover, event get/splice/recover_dentries on mdlog or purge_queue; refuses (-EPERM) if the selected rank is active (with <fs>:all only rank 0 is checked).

features.name: cephfs-table-tool
features.description: reset/show session, snap, inode tables and take_inos on mds<rank>_sessionmap, mds<rank>_inotable, mds_snaptable.

features.name: cephfs-data-scan
features.description: Rebuilds metadata from data pool backtraces/layouts (cls_cephfs accumulate), injects into dirfrags, lost+found, root/mdsdir, fixes InoTable/SnapServer; pg_files lists files with objects in given PGs via libcephfs.
features.notes: Bound to C++ on-disk formats and backtraces.

features.name: cephfs-meta-injection
features.description: Show/list/amend dentry inode encodings and fnodes in dirfrag omap located via data-pool backtraces.

features.name: first-damage.py
features.description: Scans metadata pool dirfrag omap values for dentry 'first' > next snap from mds_snaptable; removes or repairs keys.

features.name: cephfs-tool bench and cephfs-shell
features.description: libcephfs-only benchmark (ll_create/open/nonblocking IO/fsync) and interactive shell (du via ceph.dir.rbytes, quotas, snapshots, xattrs, statfs).

features.name: telemetry MDS data collection
features.description: Opt-in telemetry reads mds_sessions.session_count, mds_mem.{ino,dn,cap}, mds.subtrees, rank-0 mds.root_{rfiles,rbytes,rsnaps} and mds metadata keys; with the perf_memory_metrics collection it sends MCommands 'heap stats' (expects tcmalloc text with 12 integers) and 'dump_mempools' (JSON) to every MDS in mds_metadata.
features.notes: Only when the cluster opted in; not a POSIX feature.

features.name: ceph-exporter asok ping and counters
features.description: ceph-exporter pings each daemon admin socket with {"prefix":"0"} (expects a 1-char version), then 'counter dump', 'counter schema' (filtered by exporter_prio_limit=5) and 'config show' (pid_file, then /proc/<pid>/stat); ceph_daemon_socket_up reflects only the ping.

features.name: subvolume open side effects
features.description: Every subvolume command constructs a subvolume object (stat /volumes/_legacy/<md5>.meta), re-reads .meta, re-sets ceph.dir.subvolume=1 (MDS rdlock-only fast path when already set), may readdir .snap to clean stale SNAP_METADATA sections, and stats the data dir; even 'info' issues a SETXATTR.

serialization_points.name: session ls / client ls under mds_lock
serialization_points.why_serialized: Dump iterates all sessions; taken with the big lock
serialization_points.notes: Consumed by stats (rank 0 every mgr_stats_period) and dashboard; only needs a consistent snapshot of the session table.

serialization_points.name: session evict / client evict under mds_lock
serialization_points.shared_state: SessionMap, client blocklist, caps of matched sessions
serialization_points.why_serialized: Eviction mutates session and cap state
serialization_points.notes: Issued by volumes evict to every rank in parallel threads and by dashboard.

serialization_points.name: ceph.dir.subvolume / snaps.visible / quota vxattr set
serialization_points.why_serialized: Changes realm membership of the subtree; xlock_policylock with snaplock xlock; no early reply
serialization_points.notes: Called on every subvolume open by mgr/volumes (idempotent fast path takes only rdlock on snaplock).

serialization_points.name: pin / charmap vxattr set
serialization_points.shared_state: inode policylock (charmap also rdlocks filelock to check emptiness)
serialization_points.why_serialized: Policy fields of one dir inode

serialization_points.name: snapshot create/remove/rename/metadata
serialization_points.shared_state: SnapServer table on the tableserver rank + realm of the dir
serialization_points.why_serialized: Snap ids are global and allocated through 2PC with the snap table
serialization_points.notes: Driven by volumes, snap_schedule timers, dashboard, mirror daemon (remote mksnap), mirroring checkpoints (SNAP_METADATA).

serialization_points.name: shared /volumes directory
serialization_points.shared_state: dirfrag of /volumes holding $<auth>.meta and _<g>:<s>.meta files and internal dirs
serialization_points.why_serialized: All subvolume creates/removes/authorize touch files directly in /volumes
serialization_points.notes: Layout choice of mgr/volumes; any subvolume-sharded MDS still sees cross-subvolume traffic here.

serialization_points.name: shared trash dir /volumes/_deleting
serialization_points.why_serialized: Every subvolume removal renames its base dir into _deleting (cross-directory rename)
serialization_points.notes: Rename of a subvolume root out of /volumes/<group> into _deleting.

serialization_points.name: shared clone index /volumes/_index/clone
serialization_points.why_serialized: All clones of a volume create/unlink symlinks here; cloner scans it

serialization_points.name: group directory /volumes/<group>
serialization_points.why_serialized: Subvolume create (mkdirs) and trash rename modify the group dir

serialization_points.name: .meta atomic rewrite (rename over existing)
serialization_points.shared_state: dentries .meta and .meta.tmp in the subvolume base dir
serialization_points.why_serialized: Atomic replace of the metadata file
serialization_points.notes: Happens for every state transition, user metadata change and clone attach/detach (on source and destination).

serialization_points.name: flock on auth metadata files
serialization_points.shared_state: file lock state of one inode

serialization_points.name: mgr/volumes GlobalLock
serialization_points.shared_state: all volumes commands in the mgr process
serialization_points.why_serialized: Module design: one big lock held for every open_volume
serialization_points.notes: mgr-side; limits concurrency of subvolume admin operations regardless of MDS design.

serialization_points.name: quiesce db leader
serialization_points.shared_state: quiesce db of the filesystem on the leader MDS

serialization_points.name: perf metric aggregation on rank 0
serialization_points.why_serialized: Only rank 0 aggregates client/subvolume metrics and reports to the mgr

serialization_points.name: mirror daemon directory lock
serialization_points.shared_state: flock on remote mirrored dir root
serialization_points.why_serialized: Ensures one mirror daemon syncs a directory

serialization_points.name: clone admission count across all volumes
serialization_points.shared_state: /volumes/_index/clone of every filesystem; mgr GlobalLock taken once per filesystem
serialization_points.why_serialized: snapshot_clone_no_wait pre-check opens every volume with open_volume and readdirs its clone index before accepting a clone
serialization_points.notes: mgr-side; generates sessions/readdir on unrelated filesystems for each clone request.

external_contract.detail: uid/gid 0, client_quota=false, check_pool_perm=false, snapshot visibility not respected, fscrypt_as=false; up to 5 sessions per fs per pool; abort_conn on fs recreation; addresses blocklisted on mgr failover
set '1' idempotent on every subvolume open; get via GETVXATTR returns '1'/'0'; nested subvolume EINVAL
rename/link across subvolume roots -> EXDEV; mksnap below subvolume root -> EPERM
ceph.quota.max_bytes/max_files set (0 removes) and read from InodeStat quota
ceph.dir.layout.pool/pool_namespace set; read from InodeStat dir layout; root dir must expose a layout
ceph.dir.pin int (EDOM >= MAX_MDS), pin.distributed bool, pin.random float [0,1] (<= mds_export_ephemeral_random_max)
casesensitive/normalization/encoding set only on empty dir without snaps (ENOTEMPTY); ceph.dir.charmap get; removexattr ceph.dir.charmap
ceph.dir.subvolume.snaps.visible set true/false; no-op 0 if no snaprealm; GETVXATTR empty value if no snaprealm
ceph.dir.rbytes/rentries/rfiles/rsubdirs computed client-side from rstat; dir st_size = rbytes (client_dirsize_rbytes)
LSSNAP returns ancestor snapshots as _<name>_<ino>; mgr filters names starting with '_'
InodeStat.snap_btime from SnapInfo::stamp feeds ceph.snap.btime (sec.nsec), parsed as created_at
EMLINK at mds_max_snaps_per_dir, EEXIST on duplicate name (treated as success)
blocking flock LOCK_EX with explicit owner on auth metadata files
atomic replacement of .meta by .meta.tmp after fsync
symlink st_size == target length; symlink ctime used to order clone jobs

MCommand 'session evict' with filters auth_name=<id part of cephx name>, client_metadata.root=<data path> (exact match); EAGAIN during replay; rc 0 'no hosts match'; blocklist per mds_session_blocklist_on_evict; allow_all caps required (else EACCES)

'client ls' to every daemon with rank 0 (incl. standby-replay): JSON array of Session::dump with id, client_metadata{hostname, root, mount_point?, kernel_version?, metric_spec.metric_flags.feature_bits (hex)}; hostname/root/feature_bits read without defaults by mgr/stats
args roots,set_id,timeout,expiration,await_for,await,if_version,include,exclude,reset,release,query,all,cancel; non-leader returns -ENOTTY with {epoch, leader}
'quarantine enable|disable path=<subvolume base path>' to any active MDS
MMgrConfigure MDSConfigPayload in, MMgrReport MDSMetricPayload out from rank 0; key types mds_rank/client_id/subvolume_path, counter types 0-23; client_id key = entity_inst_t string

mds_mem.{ino,dn,dir,cap}, mds_sessions.session_count, mds_server.handle_client_request, mds_log.{replayed,ev}, mds_cache.num_strays, mds.{inodes,caps,subtrees,exported_inodes,imported_inodes} with priority >= mgr_stats_threshold
'scrub status' key every mds_task_status_update_interval while scrubbing
ceph.mirror.info only on root; stored as raw xattrs ceph.mirror.info.cluster_id/fs_id returned in xattr blob; XATTR_CREATE -> EEXIST; regex cluster_id=<uuid> fs_id=<int>
CEPH_MDS_OP_SNAP_METADATA (0x1406) with key/value/op_flag (CREATE, CREATE|EXCL, REMOVE); no check_access; uid range check only
READDIR_SNAPDIFF and FILE_BLOCKDIFF (feature bit 23) on the primary

flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB -> EWOULDBLOCK when held, plain xattr ceph.mirror.dirty_snap_id allowed under ceph. prefix, mksnap with metadata primary_snap_id, RENAMESNAP, sync_fs (flush mdlog session request)
latest snapshot determined by highest snap id
beacon carries mds_join_fs read from central config (set by cephadm)

sys_info (sent only in up:boot beacons) ceph_version ('ceph version <v> (<sha>) <release> (<type> - <build>)'), ceph_version_short, hostname, addr; used by ceph versions (cephadm upgrade parses split(' ')[2]), mds metadata (mgr list_servers, stray detection, prometheus, telemetry)

/usr/bin/ceph-mds -n mds.<id> -f --setuser ceph --setgroup ceph --default-log-to-file=false [--default-log-to-journald|stderr ...]; keyring in /var/lib/ceph/mds/ceph-<id>; caps mon 'profile mds' osd 'allow rw tag cephfs *=*' mds 'allow'
fs set allow_standby_replay 0, fs set max_mds 1 (or fs fail), mds ok-to-stop, redeploy, versions check, restore settings; rank stop/export required when max_mds lowered
admin socket must answer ping, counter dump, counter schema, config show (pid_file)
client.nfs.<cluster>.<fs>.<hash> with mds 'allow rw path=<cmount_path>' and Ganesha FSAL CEPH config; Delegations=false, RecoveryBackend rados_cluster
snap_schedule SQLite objects snap_db_v0.db.* (default ns), legacy snap_db_v0 in ns cephfs-snap-schedule, mirroring objects cephfs_mirror and cephfs_mirror.<id> live in the CephFS metadata pool

journal-tool, table-tool, data-scan, meta-injection, first-damage.py read/write C++ MDS on-disk structures directly (journal objects 0x200+rank..., mds<rank>_inotable, mds<rank>_sessionmap, mds_snaptable, dirfrag omap, backtraces)
cephadm may rotate an MDS daemon's cephx key (mgr.key_rotate) before redeploying it during an upgrade; the daemon restarts with the new keyring

MDS must advertise CEPHFS_FEATURE_OP_GETVXATTR (17) or libcephfs turns every MDS-served ceph.* getxattr (ceph.dir.subvolume, snaps.visible, charmap, pin.random/distributed, layout.json/pool_name/pool_id) into -ENODATA; reply payload is ENCODE_START(1,1) string
volumes writes user.ceph.subvolume.earmark/enctag with empty values (set, not remove); getxattr must return a 0-length value, not ENODATA

mksnap: EPERM if allow_new_snaps unset or caller uid outside mds_snap_min/max_uid or below a subvolume root; EINVAL for empty names, leading '_' or > 240 bytes; EMLINK at mds_max_snaps_per_dir; EEXIST duplicates
READDIR_SNAPDIFF 0x1404, FILE_BLOCKDIFF 0x1405, SNAP_METADATA 0x1406 all carry CEPH_MDS_OP_WRITE; the C++ MDS returns EROFS for them when read-only (may_write check)
volumes forwards its whole cmd dict to 'quiesce db' (vol_name, members, group_name, leader, with_leader extra keys); the MDS command layer validates only declared args and ignores the rest
opt-in telemetry perf_memory_metrics sends 'heap stats' (tcmalloc text) and 'dump_mempools' (json) MCommands to each MDS by name
asok request {"prefix":"0"} must return a 1-character version string, used by ceph-exporter for ceph_daemon_socket_up
Beacon::_send attaches sys_info (ceph_version, hostname, addr, ...) only when want_state is up:boot; mds metadata used by ceph versions/cephadm comes from those

external_contract.item: rmdir of a directory with snapshots
external_contract.detail: rmdir of a directory whose own realm still has snapshots fails ENOTEMPTY; the volumes rmtree treats that as 'contains snapshots' and leaves the dir

rust_implications.topic: Subvolume shard identity vs mgr/volumes layout
rust_implications.implication: The shard root that mgr/volumes marks with ceph.dir.subvolume is /volumes/<g>/<s> for v2 (uuid dir for v1), but quotas, layouts, cephx path caps, evict root filters and quiesce roots use the data dir /volumes/<g>/<s>/<uuid>. A subvolume shard must contain both, and must accept that .meta, .trash and .snap live at the base dir.

Subvolume removal renames the subvolume root out of /volumes/<group> into /volumes/_deleting; clone tracking creates symlinks in /volumes/_index/clone; auth metadata files live directly in /volumes. These are unavoidable cross-shard (subvolume <-> volume-level dir) mutations; design the 2PC path to be cheap for 'rename whole shard root to another parent'.

mgr purge threads delete subvolume trees with millions of unlinkat/rmdir requests (rmtree) from few sessions; the Rust MDS should make unlink throughput and stray purge per shard efficient, and could offer (without breaking the unmodified mgr) fast paths for whole-subtree removal only if the mgr is changed later.

Other components store objects in the CephFS metadata pool default namespace (snap_db_v0.db.*, cephfs_mirror, cephfs_mirror.<id>) and in namespace cephfs-snap-schedule. A free Rust on-disk format should live in its own RADOS namespace (or name prefix) and never list/delete foreign objects; MDS caps allow rw on all cephfs-tagged pools.

cephfs-journal-tool, cephfs-table-tool, cephfs-data-scan, cephfs-meta-injection and first-damage.py are bound to the C++ formats; a Rust MDS needs its own recovery tooling and must document that these binaries are unsupported (they run without an online check except journal-tool, so they could corrupt a Rust-formatted pool).

cephfs-data-scan depends on 'parent' (backtrace) and 'layout' xattrs on 0th data objects; if the Rust MDS wants data-pool-based disaster recovery it needs an equivalent per-file back-pointer on data objects (kclient/libcephfs never read them).

rust_implications.topic: Perf counters and mgr metrics protocol
rust_implications.implication: fs status, dashboard, prometheus and ceph-exporter read specific perf counter names (mds_mem.*, mds_sessions.session_count, mds_server.handle_client_request, mds_log.replayed, ...) via MMgrReport/asok; fs perf stats and cephfs-top need the MDS perf-metric query protocol answered by a single aggregator (rank 0 in C++). Per-subvolume metrics map naturally to subvolume shards but must still be exported through the subvolume_path key type.

Implement 'session ls'/'client ls' (same JSON field names), 'session evict'/'client evict' with the SessionFilter grammar, 'quiesce db' (including -ENOTTY + {leader} redirect), 'quarantine enable|disable', and the allow_all check for MCommand. In C++ session ls/evict hold mds_lock; in Rust they only need a consistent per-rank session table view.

The cephadm-deployed cephfs-mirror daemon has mds 'allow r' yet writes checkpoint snapshot metadata on the primary; C++ performs no check_access for CEPH_MDS_OP_SNAP_METADATA. Adding a write-cap check in Rust would break mirroring checkpoints in unmodified deployments.

Mirroring relies on globally monotonic snap ids. In C++ snap metadata updates overwrite SnapInfo.stamp, changing ceph.snap.btime (created_at). Decide explicitly whether to reproduce this visible behavior.

mgr/volumes holds a process-wide GlobalLock for every command, so per-subvolume admin operations stay serialized no matter how concurrent the MDS is; MDS concurrency benefits will show for client I/O, clone copies and purges, not for 'fs subvolume' command rates.

cephadm 'orch upgrade' performs an in-place rolling restart with max_mds=1 (or fs fail); since the Rust MDS cannot read C++ metadata, replacing C++ daemons via the upgrade path is impossible; a Rust deployment needs a new filesystem (fs new) or a data migration, and cephadm upgrades between Rust versions must keep the max_mds reduction/standby-replay toggling working (rank stop + subtree export semantics).

To run under unmodified cephadm the Rust binary must be /usr/bin/ceph-mds in the image, accept -n mds.<id> -f --setuser/--setgroup and --default-log-* options, read keyring/conf from the standard paths, expose the admin socket, honor mds_join_fs from the mon config store and report ceph_version metadata in the 'ceph version <v> (<sha>) <release> (<type> - <build>)' format.

Many vxattrs used by mgr modules are computed client-side from InodeStat (rstat, quota, dir layout, dir pin, snap_btime, snap_metadata, fscrypt fields, raw ceph.mirror.info.* xattrs); the Rust MDS must fill these fields, return -ENODATA for unknown ceph.* GETVXATTR names (fallback to plain xattrs), and give the root dir a layout.

mgr/volumes depends on rename-over-existing being atomic and on fsync for crash consistency of .meta; auth metadata uses truncate+write under flock. Journal ordering in the Rust shard must preserve these POSIX guarantees.

rust_implications.topic: Keeping Rust and C++ daemons off each other's filesystems
rust_implications.implication: In a mixed cluster the mon may hand any standby to any filesystem; mds_join_fs (set by cephadm) is only a preference. FSMap::get_available_standby (src/mds/FSMap.cc:804-823) skips standbys whose CompatSet cannot write the fs compat (and, for non-upgradeable filesystems, standbys that would add incompat bits). A Rust MDS that advertises its own incompat feature bit, and a Rust-created fs that requires it, would keep C++ daemons off Rust filesystems and vice versa; verify the exact rules in the beacon-and-monitor page before relying on it.

rust_implications.topic: Feature bits the unmodified mgr tooling needs
rust_implications.implication: Advertise CEPHFS_FEATURE_OP_GETVXATTR (17) or mgr/volumes cannot read ceph.dir.subvolume / snaps.visible / charmap, and CEPHFS_FEATURE_BLOCKDIFF (23) or cephfs-mirror's blockdiff requests fail EOPNOTSUPP; CEPHFS_FEATURE_METRIC_COLLECT (14) for fs perf stats.

The Rust MCommand/asok layer must ignore undeclared keys (mgr/volumes sends extra keys with 'quiesce db') and must keep 'client ls' entries carrying client_metadata.hostname/root/metric_spec, or mgr/stats breaks for the whole reply.

open_questions: Rook operator (outside this repo) MDS upgrade and failover choreography (does it use fs fail, max_mds reduction, allow_standby_replay toggling?) is unverified.

SNAP_METADATA permission: no check_access in Server::handle_client_snap_md_op, and none in handle_client_request, dispatch_client_request, rdlock_path_pin_ref, MDCache or Locker (checked); whether a Rust MDS should keep allowing it for 'allow r' clients is a policy decision (cephfs-mirror depends on it).
The smb mgr module also uses subvolume earmarks (smb scope) and libcephfs; it was not analyzed here.
Which perf counters the prometheus module actually exports depends on mgr_stats_threshold and counter priorities; not enumerated.
Should the Rust MDS reproduce C++ quirks visible to tools (snap btime overwritten by snap metadata ops, dashboard reading non-existent mds_log.replay, mds.exported/imported at PRIO_DEBUGONLY)?
How should cephadm 'orch upgrade' be prevented or adapted when switching a cluster from C++ to Rust MDS images (no in-place format compatibility)?
What should a non-tcmalloc Rust MDS answer to telemetry's 'heap stats' tell command (telemetry only logs an error if the output does not contain 'tcmalloc heap stats')?
Interplay of mds_autoscaler (if enabled) with cephadm upgrade's max_mds=1 reduction: the autoscaler re-applies mds.<fs> count = 1 + standby_count_wanted; not coordinated in code.

Feature-bit numbering mismatch: the kclient in the reference tree defines CEPHFS_FEATURE_SUBVOLUME_METRICS as bit 22 (linux/fs/ceph/mds_client.h) while the C++ MDS uses bit 22 for CEPHFS_FEATURE_CHARMAP (src/mds/cephfs_features.h:53); which bit a Rust MDS should advertise for subvolume metrics needs to be settled with the kclient-expectations page.
